name: Apichatpong Weerasethakul

films.title: Tropical Malady
films.overview: A romance between a soldier and country boy is ruptured by the boy’s sudden disappearance. Their story turns into a mythical venture based on Thai folklore.

films.title: Syndromes and a Century
films.overview: A story about director Apichatpong Weerasethakul's parents who were both doctors, and his memories of growing up in a hospital environment.

films.title: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
films.overview: Suffering from a kidney disease and sure of his death, Uncle Boonmee assembles his relatives in the countryside. He reminisces about his past lives and plans to visit a place before dying.

films.title: Blissfully Yours
films.overview: In Thailand, an illegal immigrant from Myanmar with a mysterious skin rash, his girlfriend, and her friend visit the doctor's before spending the afternoon on individual and collective adventures.

films.title: Cemetery of Splendor
films.overview: In a hospital, ten soldiers are being treated for a mysterious sleeping sickness. In a story in which dreams can be experienced by others, and in which goddesses can sit casually with mortals, a nurse learns the reason why the patients will never be cured, and forms a telepathic bond with one of them.

films.title: Memoria
films.overview: After hearing a loud 'bang' at daybreak, a Scottish woman begins experiencing a mysterious sensory syndrome while traversing the jungles of Colombia.

known_for: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
